one_line: Ilbari Turk slave-turned-sultan of Delhi, austere ruler and defender of the northwest frontier against Mongol threats.

appearance.age_look: Late 50s, medium-tall, wiry but solid build with a disciplined, commanding posture.
appearance.face: Long, angular face with high cheekbones, sharp nose, deep-set intense dark eyes under straight brows, neatly trimmed square beard with a few grey streaks, medium-wheat complexion, default expression stern and focused with a hint of contained steel rather than anger.
appearance.hair: Straight, dark brown hair with slight greying at the temples, kept short and tidy and mostly hidden under a deep crimson, slightly conical Turkic-style quilted war cap circled by a narrow dark leather band and a simple central metal boss, no plume.
appearance.costume: Long-sleeved quilted brigandine-style coat (kazaghand) reaching mid-calf in dark indigo cotton with subtle vertical stitch lines and small rivet heads, worn over a knee-length, high-collared royal blue silk tunic belted with a broad dark brown leather girdle; loose cream cotton trousers tucked into mid-calf soft leather riding boots in dark brown; over the armor a sleeveless, slightly flared surcoat in rich crimson with narrow gold edging and a simple repeated small geometric motif along the hem; forearms protected by fitted leather bracers, and a plain silver signet ring on his right hand; he wears no ostentatious jewelry beyond a thin gold chain barely visible at the throat, emphasizing austerity.
appearance.signature: A slightly curved Indo-Turkic steel sword (shamshir) with a dark leather-wrapped hilt, simple crossguard, and a plain steel scabbard banded in dark leather, worn at his left hip and often held lightly in his right hand, point downward in a controlled, ready stance.

ref_desc: Ghiyas-ud-Din Balban is a stern late-fifties Ilbari Turk with a long angular face, short dark hair under a crimson war cap, indigo quilted coat over royal blue tunic, cream trousers, crimson gold-edged surcoat, and a plain-hilt curved steel shamshir at his hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model of Ghiyas-ud-Din Balban: a late-fifties Ilbari Turk with a long angular face, deep-set intense eyes, neatly trimmed square beard and short dark hair mostly hidden by a deep crimson, slightly conical Turkic quilted war cap with a narrow dark leather band and central metal boss. His expression is stern and focused, projecting controlled authority. He wears a long-sleeved quilted brigandine-style indigo coat reaching mid-calf, with visible vertical stitch lines and small rivet heads, over a knee-length high-collared royal blue silk tunic, belted with a broad dark brown leather girdle. Loose cream cotton trousers tuck into mid-calf dark brown soft leather riding boots. Over the armor lies a sleeveless flared crimson surcoat with narrow gold edging and a repeated small geometric motif along the hem; his forearms have fitted leather bracers, and a thin gold chain peeks at his throat, with a plain silver signet ring on his right hand. At his left hip hangs his signature slightly curved Indo-Turkic steel sword (shamshir) in a plain steel-and-leather scabbard, its dark leather-wrapped hilt and simple crossguard visible; pose him holding the sheathed sword lightly in his right hand, point down, ready but controlled. Use crimson, indigo, royal blue, cream, dark brown, steel grey and gold trim as the dominant colors, and present him front-facing with clear head-to-toe costume details for consistent redrawing.
